entry.summary: This retrospective includes 16 papers from the owner correction and evidence-library restoration list, recommended by HF during October 14–27. Recommendation and original publication dates are shown separately. Starting October 28, daily editions follow HF daily recommendations and new updates from other sources, subject to owner review.
